topic: Data aggregation failure and job timing
summary_markdown:
A data monitoring issue was identified where the aggregation process failed silently on production during a recalculation. While ML predictions ran normally, the final step of the aggregation did not execute on prod, although it passed successfully on staging and beta environments. The job duration was noted as being unusually long (5 hours), suggesting potential hang-ups in the process.

Later analysis provided timing details: 2 hours were allocated for ML jobs (45 minutes each for traffic on staging and production), and an additional 1 hour 45 minutes was required for aggregation. The remaining time was attributed to session processing.
decisions: The silent failure of the final aggregation step on production was confirmed.
